main_text.p: סַרְבְּלִיּם m.p. Chald. Chlamydes, Pallia: בְּסַרְבְּלֵיהֽוֹן Cum chlamydibus suis, Dan.3.21.
סִרְיוֹן סְרָה m. Lorica: plur. סִרְיוֹנוֹת.
סָרָה Redundare, Luxuriare. Niphal נִסְרָה Redundans, Superfluum esse.
סָרְנִין סָרִין m.p. Satrapae: item Tabula.
סָרִיס סָרִים m. Eunuchus, Cubicularius: Aulicus: plur. סָרִיסִים.
סַרְעַפָּה f. Ramus, Ramusculus: plurale, סַרְעַפּוֹת.
סַתּוּ סַתָּה m. Hyems: Chaldaum proprie.
סָתַם Pihel סִתֵּם Obturare, Obstruere, Occludere. Niphal נִסְתַּם Occludi.
סָתַר Abscondere se. Niphal נִסְתַּר Abscondi, Abscondere se, Latere. Est & pro.
Pihel סִתֵּר Abscondere. Pyhal סֻתַּר Occultari. Hiphil הִסְתִּיר Occultare, Celare, Abscondere. Hithpahel הִסְתַּתֵּר

page.notes: Hebrew and Latin text is set in mixed type; some Hebrew vowel points and the final line's Hebrew are uncertain in the scan. The "K 2" signature is at the foot; the faint stamp at lower left and the digitiser's watermark at lower right are omitted.
